theme.en: AI Compute Expands Beyond the GPU

dek.en: Custom silicon, high-bandwidth memory, cooling, and software are becoming co-equal constraints on AI deployment. Policy proposals are increasingly following the compute wherever it is accessed.
dek.zh: 定制芯片、高带宽存储、散热和软件正成为AI部署中同等重要的约束。政策方案也开始追随算力的实际访问路径而延伸。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Google’s Marvell deal broadens custom silicon beyond TPU
title.zh: Google与Marvell的合作将定制芯片扩展至TPU之外

summary.en: Google’s expanded relationship with Marvell points to custom silicon work beyond the TPU itself, including memory, networking, storage, and data movement. Those surrounding subsystems can determine how much useful work an AI cluster extracts from its accelerators.
summary.zh: Google扩大与Marvell的合作，显示定制硅的范围正从TPU本身延伸到存储、网络、存储设备和数据搬运。这些外围子系统会决定AI集群能从加速器中释放多少实际有效算力。

title.en: B200 cooling study compares two-phase and single-phase direct-to-chip designs
title.zh: B200散热研究比较两相与单相直触芯片方案

summary.en: A benchmarking study examines two-phase versus single-phase direct-to-chip cooling on an NVIDIA B200 server, including warm-water operation. As accelerator densities rise, the cooling choice affects both sustained performance and the electricity and water economics of the data center.
summary.zh: 一项基准研究在NVIDIA B200服务器上比较两相和单相直触芯片冷却，并考察温水运行条件。随着加速器功率密度提升，散热方案同时影响持续性能以及数据中心的电力和用水经济性。

title.en: AMD releases ROCm 10 with claimed inference uplift
title.zh: AMD发布ROCm 10并宣称推理性能提升

summary.en: AMD has released ROCm 10, its latest open compute and AI software stack, and says it delivers up to 3.3× inference uplift over ROCm 7 in its cited comparisons. The release puts software maturity alongside hardware availability as a competitive variable for AMD’s AI accelerator users.
summary.zh: AMD发布了最新的开放计算与AI软件栈ROCm 10，并在其引用的对比中宣称相对ROCm 7最高可实现3.3倍推理提升。该版本表明，对AMD AI加速器用户而言，软件成熟度与硬件供给同样是竞争变量。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix breaks ground on $4 billion Indiana HBM plant
title.zh: SK hynix为40亿美元印第安纳HBM工厂破土动工

summary.en: SK hynix has broken ground on a $4 billion HBM plant in Indiana, extending advanced-memory production and packaging investment into the United States. The new site adds a geographically distinct supply-chain node for AI memory, a component that increasingly gates accelerator-system deliveries.
summary.zh: SK hynix已为其位于印第安纳州、投资40亿美元的HBM工厂破土动工，将先进存储生产与封装投资延伸至美国。该项目为AI存储增加了一个地域上独立的供应链节点，而这一环节正日益限制加速器系统交付。

title.en: Qualcomm’s HBC initiative draws Samsung and SK hynix into a post-HBM race
title.zh: Qualcomm的HBC布局将Samsung和SK hynix带入HBM之后的新竞争

summary.en: Qualcomm’s reported HBC initiative is drawing Samsung and SK hynix into a new memory race beyond conventional HBM. The development underscores how AI-memory differentiation is moving toward system-level bandwidth, packaging, and interface choices rather than capacity alone.
summary.zh: 报道称，Qualcomm的HBC布局正将Samsung和SK hynix带入传统HBM之外的新一轮存储竞争。这表明AI存储的差异化正从单纯容量转向系统级带宽、封装和接口选择。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC bonuses rise 50.6% as the cost of AI talent climbs
title.zh: 台积电奖金增长50.6%，AI人才成本上升

summary.en: TSMC paid NT$36 billion in second-quarter bonuses, a 50.6% year-on-year increase, while revenue rose 36% to NT$1.2 trillion, according to its SEC filings cited in the report. The divergence highlights workforce retention as a rising cost in the advanced-node expansion serving AI demand.
summary.zh: 据报道援引的SEC文件，台积电第二季度发放360亿新台币奖金，同比增长50.6%，同期营收增长36%至1.2万亿新台币。这一增速差异凸显出，在服务AI需求的先进制程扩张中，留住人才正成为不断上升的成本。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Lam Research breaks ground on Oregon AI semiconductor lab
title.zh: Lam Research为俄勒冈AI半导体实验室破土动工

summary.en: Lam Research has broken ground on an AI semiconductor laboratory in Oregon. For process-equipment suppliers, closer work on AI-oriented device and process problems can help translate new architectures and materials requirements into manufacturable process flows.
summary.zh: Lam Research已为其位于俄勒冈州的AI半导体实验室破土动工。对于制程设备供应商而言，围绕AI导向器件和工艺问题开展更紧密的研究，有助于将新架构与材料需求转化为可制造的工艺流程。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: US export-control proposal targets Chinese remote access to AI servers
title.zh: 美国出口管制提案瞄准中国对远程AI服务器的访问

summary.en: The Trump administration is reportedly drafting an export-control rule aimed at Chinese remote access to advanced AI computing, with an industry consultation possible as early as September. Extending controls from physical chip shipments to remote use would broaden the compliance perimeter for cloud providers and AI infrastructure operators.
summary.zh: 报道称，特朗普政府正在起草一项出口管制规则，旨在限制中国远程访问先进AI算力，并可能最早于9月向行业征询意见。若管制从实体芯片出货延伸至远程使用，云服务商和AI基础设施运营商的合规边界将随之扩大。

title.en: Nvidia forms employee PAC for Washington engagement
title.zh: Nvidia成立员工PAC以加强华盛顿政策参与

summary.en: Nvidia has formed a federal political action committee for employees, according to the report. The move formalizes the company’s policy engagement as export rules, competition scrutiny, and infrastructure incentives increasingly affect the market for AI systems.
summary.zh: 据报道，Nvidia已成立面向员工的联邦政治行动委员会。随着出口规则、竞争审查和基础设施激励日益影响AI系统市场，这一举措将公司的政策参与进一步制度化。

title.en: US considers additional semiconductor tariffs that could include data-center servers
title.zh: 美国考虑新增半导体关税，数据中心服务器或被纳入

summary.en: The administration is considering additional semiconductor tariffs that could extend to data-center servers, according to the report. Including finished systems would make trade policy relevant not only to component sourcing but also to the location and cost structure of AI infrastructure deployment.
summary.zh: 据报道，政府正在考虑新增半导体关税，范围可能延伸至数据中心服务器。若将整机纳入，贸易政策将不仅影响零部件采购，也会影响AI基础设施部署的地点选择和成本结构。

theme.zh: 推理效率遇上设计流程约束

dek.en: This week’s work ranges from low-cost model training and speculative decoding to VLM acceleration and EDA orchestration. Together, the papers frame hardware efficiency as a systems problem spanning algorithms, deployment, and design tools.
dek.zh: 本周研究覆盖低成本模型训练、推测式解码、VLM加速和EDA编排。这些工作共同表明，硬件效率是横跨算法、部署和设计工具的系统性问题。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Vision-Centric Generative AI Models: A Software-Hardware Perspective
title.zh: 以视觉为中心的生成式AI模型：软硬件视角

papers.authors: E. Tselepi, C. Sestito, S. Agwa, T. Prodromakis

summary.en: This perspective maps vision-generative model families to deployment domains and compares their parameter cost and energy efficiency across accelerator platforms. It argues that edge uses such as vehicles, sensors, and mobile devices require software-hardware co-design from the outset, rather than adapting hardware after models have already grown.
summary.zh: 该观点论文将视觉生成模型家族映射到不同部署领域，并比较其在多类加速器平台上的参数成本和能效。论文认为，车辆、传感器和移动设备等边缘应用需要从一开始就进行软硬件协同设计，而不是在模型规模增长后再被动调整硬件。

title.en: AI Systems & Hardware Co-Design
title.zh: AI系统与软硬件协同设计

title.en: Puro-2B: A Low-Cost Qwen2-1.5B Training Recipe on RTX 5090
title.zh: Puro-2B：在RTX 5090上低成本训练Qwen2-1.5B的方案

papers.authors: K. Luo, J. Cui, Y. Yin, et al.

summary.en: Puro-2B presents an open pretraining recipe that trains a 2B-parameter model on consumer RTX 5090 GPUs using FP8 and up to 1.4 trillion tokens. The authors report a best-model compute cost below $6.9K while approaching Qwen2.5-1.5B under their evaluation protocol, making the result a useful cost data point rather than a direct substitute for frontier-scale training.
summary.zh: Puro-2B提出一套开放预训练方案，采用FP8并在消费级RTX 5090 GPU上处理最多1.4万亿token来训练20亿参数模型。作者报告最佳模型的计算成本低于6900美元，并在其评测协议下接近Qwen2.5-1.5B；这一结果提供了有价值的成本数据点，但并不能直接替代前沿规模训练。

title.en: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting
title.zh: 超越并行盲区：块级草稿生成中的信息下界与模型差距

papers.authors: X. Qiang, X. Fang, C. Chen, et al.

summary.en: The paper separates speculative block-drafting rejections into an unavoidable information floor and a model-quality gap. Across four domains and several target models, one realized token removes 86–100% of the final-slot information floor, while current drafters remain substantially above that floor.
summary.zh: 论文将推测式块级草稿生成的拒绝划分为不可避免的信息下界和模型质量差距。在四个领域及多个目标模型上，一个已实现token可消除最终位置86%至100%的信息下界，但现有草稿器仍明显高于这一界限。

title.en: PACE: Pixel-Adaptive Condense and Extract for Fast VLM Inference
title.zh: PACE：用于快速VLM推理的像素自适应压缩与提取

papers.authors: J. Liu, S. Ye, X. Chen

summary.en: PACE is a training-free VLM inference method that reduces work before the vision encoder and then selectively retains visual tokens for the language model. By treating input pixels and post-encoder tokens as one pipeline, it targets latency that conventional token-pruning methods leave in visual encoding.
summary.zh: PACE是一种免训练的VLM推理方法：先在视觉编码器之前减少计算量，再为语言模型选择性保留视觉token。它将输入像素和编码器后的token视为同一条流水线，从而瞄准传统token剪枝方法遗留在视觉编码阶段的延迟。

title.en: Electronic Design Automation
title.zh: 电子设计自动化

title.en: LLMs in Digital EDA: From Generation to Orchestration
title.zh: 数字EDA中的LLM：从生成走向编排

papers.authors: M. Youngman, C. Sestito, T. Prodromakis

summary.en: This perspective classifies LLM roles in digital EDA as generators, agents, and orchestrators coordinating decisions across design stages. It warns that code which appears syntactically plausible can still be physically incorrect, while fragmented tools and lost context obstruct industrial-scale use.
summary.zh: 该观点论文将LLM在数字EDA中的角色分为生成器、代理和跨设计阶段协调决策的编排器。论文警告，看似语法正确的代码仍可能在物理实现上错误，而工具碎片化和上下文丢失仍阻碍工业规模应用。

title.en: Quantum Technologies
title.zh: 量子技术

title.en: Diamond Quantum-Sensing Platform with Integrated Microwave Antenna and Thermometer
title.zh: 集成微波天线与温度计的金刚石量子传感平台

papers.authors: M. Ohkuma, R. Matsumoto, S. Adachi, et al.

summary.en: The authors integrate an NV-center quantum-sensing layer, a boron-doped diamond microwave antenna, and a local thermometer on one diamond substrate. The platform detected laser-induced heating not clearly resolved by a stage thermometer while imaging superconductors at cryogenic temperature.
summary.zh: 作者在同一金刚石衬底上集成NV中心量子传感层、硼掺杂金刚石微波天线和局部温度计。该平台在低温下对超导体进行成像时，检测到了台式温度计未能清晰分辨的激光局部升温。
